list.intro: Change requests from the office, the floor, customers, sample rounds and suppliers; change orders that carry them to a new revision; the SMV changes waiting from Operations.
list.emptyBody: No change requests: raise the first one when a style should change.
list.noMatchBody: Clear the filters or try another search.
list.foot: A change order is approved by someone other than its author; releasing it releases the new revision and makes the old one obsolete.
list.pickOne: Pick one change to decide it

approvals.orderHint: The change order carries it to approval; its approvers decide there.

released.emptyBody: A style revision appears here once it is released.
released.foot: Style revisions released, newest first; the change order that released each, when there is one.

dialog.cancelBody: Its draft revision stays a draft; the requests it carries can go into another change order.
dialog.releaseBody: Revision {to} becomes the released one and revision {from} obsolete, through the release check; the requests it carries are done.
dialog.startBody: A copy of revision {from} becomes the draft that holds this change; edit its BOM, spec and routing in the Style studio.
dialog.changeNoteHint: What the revision changes (kept with the revision).

problem.unavailable: The factory server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not read this.
problem.notFound: Not found: it may have been removed or belong to another company.
problem.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in again.
problem.contract: The answer was not what this page expects. Reload the page.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a moment.
problem.stale: Someone changed it first: it was read again.
problem.writeForbidden: Your role does not do this here.

refusal.REQUEST_DECIDED: This request is decided: what, why and the revision no longer change.
refusal.REQUEST_MOVE: This request cannot move that way now.
refusal.REASON_NEEDED: Say why: whoever wrote or raised it reads the reason.
refusal.REQUEST_NOT_LINKABLE: A request is carried only if it is of the same style, not rejected or done, and in no other live change order.
refusal.ORDER_NOT_DRAFT: What the change order changes was fixed when it was submitted.
refusal.ORDER_MOVE: The change order is not in a state that allows this.
refusal.NO_RELEASED_REVISION: The style has no released revision: a change order starts from one.
refusal.REVISION_NOT_DRAFT: The proposed revision is no longer a draft.
refusal.DRAFT_EXISTS: The style already has a draft revision: use it, or finish it first.
refusal.NO_DRAFT_REVISION: Start the draft revision first, make the change there, then submit.
refusal.NO_APPROVER: Name at least one required approver other than the author.
refusal.OWN_APPROVAL: The author cannot approve their own change order (four eyes).
refusal.SELF_NAMED: Nobody names themselves an approver: someone else names who decides it (four eyes).
refusal.OWN_REQUEST: You raised a request this change order carries: a person who did not ask for the change decides it (four eyes).
refusal.APPROVER_CANNOT: That person’s role does not approve change orders for this company.
refusal.NOT_APPROVER: You are not an approver of this change order.
refusal.ALREADY_DECIDED: You already decided it: a decision is given once.
refusal.NOT_APPROVED: Its revision is released once the change order is approved.
refusal.NOT_YET_EFFECTIVE: It takes effect on a later day: release it on that day.
refusal.EFFECT_DATE: Say the day it takes effect (only with "From a date").
refusal.WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN: That work order is not open: nothing of it is in progress.
refusal.LINE_INVALID: That change line is not complete.
refusal.EDIT_BLOCKED: The style’s lifecycle state does not allow this change.
refusal.NEEDS_NEW_REVISION: Start a new revision to change it.
refusal.NEEDS_CHANGE_ORDER: This style changes only through a change order.
refusal.DRAFT_UNDER_CHANGE_ORDER: The draft revision is held by a change order waiting for approval: it is frozen until decided.
refusal.REVISION_LOCKED: The revision is released and locked: it does not change.
